task: Implement GitHub issue #26 in the static React ebook viewer: in the 크게 보기 zoom overlay (web/src/ZoomView.tsx, added by #23), when the viewport resizes while a two-finger pinch or a mouse drag is held, the gesture continues from stale start values. Fix in ZoomView.tsx only: in the ResizeObserver callback rebase the held pinch (pinch.zoom *= newZoom/oldZoom); make mouse drag stop storing the start scroll and instead move from the live scrollLeft/scrollTop each pointermove, advancing the stored pointer position by what actually scrolled (keep the remainder an edge refused). About 15 lines; zoomTo, zoomAtCenter, zoom.ts and index.css unchanged.

changed_paths: web/src/ZoomView.tsx (ResizeObserver callback, onPointerDown/onPointerMove, drag ref type)
context.observed_behavior: Triage (Claude Fable 5.2, headless Chromium, HEAD 4116ea0): at 390px and 821% with two touches held, resize to 844x390 re-clamps to 379% but narrowing 100->60px leaves 3200px (dead zone down to 46px). Mouse drag at max: scroll 1406/1986 -> 423/841 after resize, then a 1px move jumps to 1405/1985. A scratch-copy build of the recommended patch passed both reproductions (1920px/227%; 422/840), did not interrupt pinches when the observer fires only for a scrollbar, and produced #23 regression probe output identical to HEAD.
context.contracts: No external API. Browser input/focus APIs only. page-flip 2.0.7 vendored and not touched. Static site, no auth, no persisted data, no new dependency.
context.test_setup: vitest pure-function tests (web/src/book.ts, web/src/zoom.ts); no jsdom. UI behaviour verified with scripted Chromium (Playwright, CDP touch emulation) against vite preview, as for PRs #14, #17, #20, #21, #24. CI runs `cd web && npm test && npm run build` and `cd web && npm run lint`; main 4116ea0 passed CI.
context.consumers: Viewer.tsx is the app's single UI component, imported only by web/src/main.tsx; ZoomView.tsx is used only by Viewer.tsx. Nothing is published as a library.
context.testing_facts: No pure function changes; the pinch rebase is one multiplication on effect-local state and the drag reads the DOM, so no unit seam worth extracting. Reproductions are scripted Chromium checks (CDP touch + setViewportSize while touches or mouse button are held); triage scripts exist in the scratchpad. Red on HEAD, green after.
context.owner_decisions: Owner accepted the triage defaults on 2026-11-20: rebase (not cancel) held gestures; include the same-cause drag cases (Ctrl+wheel/key zoom or plain wheel during a held drag). Real-device rotation check is a human step on the PR preview.
